app.name: OfferAnchor
app.tagline: Understand the offer. Check the next step.
app.instruction: Paste the new job instruction you want to understand.
app.simulation: Synthetic example: simulation, not live analysis.
app.promise: Check recruitment and onboarding requests before you act.
app.coverage: Current coverage: personal payments, personal borrowing and bank-account control. Other requests still need independent checking.

input.outcome: Add my contact results or action report
input.limit: This session has reached its evidence limit. Export or start a new session; earlier messages will not be removed automatically.
input.changed: Material changed. Analyse again before exporting.
input.languageChanged: Language changed. Analyse again before exporting; original quotations keep their language.
input.sourceHighlight: The highlighted words are from your current selected source.
input.sourceUntranslated: Quotations stay in the original language.
input.deleteBody: This changes the selected material and makes its previous result and edited brief out of date.
input.clearBody: Export any current brief you want to keep first. Clearing does not delete exported copies or processor records.

state.delayed: This is taking longer. You may cancel.
state.complete: This analysis is complete; its contents still need independent checking
state.incomplete: This analysis could not be completed. Do not treat it as a safety finding.
state.questionsExhausted: Both clarification questions have been used. Unknowns remain listed. You can still add your own note or later reply.

guidance.pause_requested_action: Pause this personal payment, borrowing or account-control action and check independently.
guidance.clarify_before_action: Clarify the details affecting personal financial exposure before deciding what to do next.
guidance.no_personal_financial_request_identified: No personal payment, borrowing or bank-account control request covered by this tool was identified in your selected text. This analysis covers only that text: the sender’s identity, promises and the job remain independently unverified. Other data requests still need separate checking.
guidance.claim: A statement in the text, not independently verified
guidance.noScopedQuestion: Which reliable company channel, found independently, can confirm the duties and this instruction?

brief.question: A question for independent checking
brief.edited: Body edited by the user; added text is not automatically evidence-verified.
brief.boundary: Prepared from selected material. Employer identity, repayment and outside events are not independently verified. Unresolved checks remain listed. Copying, using a checking channel or a contact report does not establish verification.
brief.simulation: SIMULATION: authored synthetic result, not a live model analysis.
brief.bank: If you already acted, contact your bank through a channel you independently obtain and seek appropriate official help. This tool cannot recover funds.
brief.copied: Brief copied, including its protected notice.
brief.copyFailed: Automatic copy did not work. Select and copy the complete brief and its notice below.
brief.unavailable: No current complete result is available to export. Analyse the current material first.
brief.protectedNotice: Protected notice — included in every export

privacy.notice: Selected text is sent to the application server and, in live mode, a model provider. Remove unnecessary personal details. Review the stated processor handling before submitting sensitive material.
privacy.loss: Clearing removes working state here, not exports or provider/host records. Reloading may lose your draft.
privacy.draftLost: This page may lose working material when reloaded or closed. Export any current brief you want to keep.

errors.invalid_input: Check the required source and the limits on entries, text length and data size.

errors.provider_error: The service could not produce a usable analysis.
errors.invalid_output: The returned analysis could not be validated.

K_TASK_RECHARGE.title: Your money is requested before tasks or withdrawals
K_TASK_RECHARGE.question: Pause this payment. Why is your own money required before tasks or earnings? Ask an independent adviser to help you check using a reliable channel you found yourself.

K_PERSONAL_BORROWING.title: Personal borrowing or use of borrowed funds is requested
K_PERSONAL_BORROWING.question: Pause this borrowing, transfer or payment using personal borrowing proceeds. Why does the work require borrowing in your own name, or using existing borrowed funds? Check independently; a company repayment promise remains unverified.

K_COMPANY_PAID.title: The text describes company payment or prohibits personal payment
K_COMPANY_PAID.question: Which costs are paid directly by the company? Check through a company channel you found independently; a payment statement is not confirmation.

K_PAYROLL.title: Payroll details are not bank-account control
K_PAYROLL.question: Independently check who is requesting the information and why. Do not disclose banking passwords or one-time passwords (OTPs) to them, or hand over account control.

K_UNKNOWN.title: Some details still need independent checking
K_UNKNOWN.question: Who pays or borrows, and whose money is used? Is payment required for tasks or withdrawal? Clarify missing or conflicting details that affect personal financial exposure.

K_ALREADY_ACTED.title: You report that you have already acted
K_ALREADY_ACTED.question: What payment, borrowing or account action have you taken? Seek help through your bank app opened independently or the contact details on your card. Call 18222 for anti-scam advice; suspected victims should report at a police station.

K_ORDINARY_EXPENSE.title: A work expense is not necessarily a task payment
K_ORDINARY_EXPENSE.question: What is the expense for, and who pays it? Independently check the expense policy and reimbursement conditions; a reimbursement promise is neither confirmation nor permission to pay.

ADCC_18222.label: Anti-scam advice: 18222
ADCC_18222.scope: 24-hour advice, not a crime report or employer certification. Suspected victims should report at a police station; call 999 for emergencies.

SCAMETER.label: Scameter official checking service
SCAMETER.scope: Open the official service yourself to check suspicious details. 'No record' does not mean risk-free and is not employer certification.

LABOUR_GUIDANCE.label: Labour Department: job-trap guidance
LABOUR_GUIDANCE.scope: General job-trap and checking advice; it does not authenticate a particular job or employer.

COMPANY_SEARCH.label: Companies Registry: company-search information
COMPANY_SEARCH.scope: Check registration information. A company's existence does not authorize this recruiter or payment instruction. Check official access conditions and fees.
